dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is down over 19% today, Elon's MARS DOGE dream temporarily postponed as SpaceX investors freak out over Musk's wild ride. But never fear, Shiba Inu soldiers! DOGE will rise again, as it always does.

I see all you clowns losing your ass in crypto while I'm over here with my Bitcoin, hahaha! You all thought Dogecoin was gonna rocket to the moon 🚀 like that lil rocket man said, and look at it now - crashing back down to earth 😂! Solana?
"Just sipped on a cold brew, said a prayer, and got a notification that Dogecoin reached an ALL TIME HIGH! Jesus Christ, I never thought I'd see the day!
"Listen up, chumps. Betting on dogecoin right now is like rolling the dice with Tia Tequila at a strip club. It's a gamble, but damn if I wouldn't put my chips on it.

Bruh, crypto prices are straight up wack right now! Anyone else notice the price of DogeCoin is lower than a college dropout's GPA? Just wait for the next pump though, cause when that happens, I'll be buying up all the crypto ice cream I can get my hands on!
"Ah, those deep state clowns are scrambling again, huh? Well, at least we've got Dogecoin. Who needs fiat when you've got Elon Musk and his meme magic?
"Bruh, Crypto's wildin' out like my LSU game day shindigs! BTC's gettin' all tatted up while Dogecoin's waggin' its little tail hard. And I'm over here just sippin' my Abita, enjoying the hype.
